task.subject: Mail inbound authentication admission domain slice
task.description:
ChangeSet: cs-mail-inbound-authentication-admission-domain-fd001-alignment
Owner: worker-1 only. You are not alone in the codebase; do not revert or overwrite worker-2/worker-3/root edits. Use existing worker-1 mail worktree after confirming task36 is committed and worktree is clean.

Authority/context to load before editing:
- specs/root-hub-pointers.json, docs/AGENTS.md, specs/masterplan.json, specs/planning-closure-contract.json, specs/master-plan-sequencing.json, ADR-0217.
- microservices/mail/IP-006-inbound-smtp.md (DKIM/SPF/DMARC/ARC inbound requirements) and microservices/mail/IP-017-anti-phishing-edge-wiring.md (anti-phishing admission/block audit intent).
- .omc/plans/milestones/M07-first-tenant/phases/P04-connect-pro-mail/{phase-spec.md,impl-plan.md} for Connect Professional Mail acceptance gates and merge-into-existing-crates note.
- Existing patterns in crates/oya-connect-mail-domain/src/lib.rs: StrictMailContextBoundaryGuard, StrictMailRetentionDeletionDecisionGuard, StrictMailEDiscoveryExportChainCustodyGuard, MailSurfaceStaging.

Owned write scope:
- crates/oya-connect-mail-domain/src/lib.rs
- exact task39 evidence under evidence/fd001/ and evidence/multispectrum/
No root Cargo, contracts, registries, adapters, policy docs, docs, generated files, or other crates.

Implementation target:
- Add a pure zero-I/O inbound SMTP authentication/admission decision surface for the existing mail domain. This is a narrow domain guard, not a full SMTP listener or RFC parser.
- Model normalized authentication inputs for DKIM, SPF, DMARC, ARC and anti-phishing signals; validate tenant/mailbox/recipient/sender fields; refuse Personal context because Personal mail is not GA; require tenant-governed target context.
- Deterministically return Accept, Quarantine, or Reject with SMTP-style code/enhanced-status/reason labels. Fail closed for malware, high phishing score, DMARC fail/alignment failures with no DKIM/SPF pass, invalid auth evidence, and cross-context target attempts. Preserve legitimate-mail zero-friction by accepting DKIM+DMARC pass and low-risk ARC/SPF evidence.
- Add focused tests proving: valid DKIM+DMARC pass accepted; SPF-aligned fallback accepted; high phishing or malware rejected with 550 5.7.1; borderline phishing quarantined; DMARC fail with no aligned pass rejected; Personal context forbidden; cross-context refused before auth evaluation; invalid/empty fields rejected; evidence status labels stable.
- Keep business logic outside handlers and no adapter/framework logic.

Verification required before lifecycle complete:
1. cargo fmt --all --check
2. cargo test -p oya-connect-mail-domain inbound_authentication -- --nocapture
3. cargo test -p oya-connect-mail-domain -- --nocapture

5. cargo clippy -p oya-connect-mail-domain --all-targets -- -D warnings
6. cargo run -q -p oya-dev-cli -- gate validate planning-closure
7. cargo run -q -p oya-dev-cli -- gate validate data-class
8. cargo run -q -p oya-dev-cli -- gate validate architecture-boundaries
9. cargo run -q -p oya-dev-cli -- gate validate catalog
10. cargo run -q -p oya-dev-cli -- gate validate dependency-seam --evidence evidence/multispectrum/cs-mail-inbound-authentication-admission-domain-fd001-alignment.json --emit-report evidence/fd001/cs-mail-inbound-authentication-admission-domain-fd001-alignment-dependency-seam-report.json
11. cargo run -q -p oya-dev-cli -- git diff --check
12. Oya VCS claim/verify/done/promote for cs-mail-inbound-authentication-admission-domain-fd001-alignment.
